parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why the emitted $\beta^{-}$ particles have a range of energies.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: A sample of blood contains $1.2 \times 10^{-9} \text{ g}$ of iodine-131. Determine, for this sample of blood,

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: the time for the activity of the iodine-131 to be reduced to $1/50$ of the activity calculated in (i).

stem: The isotope iodine-131 ($^{131}_{53}\text{I}$) is radioactive with a decay constant of $8.6 \times 10^{-2} \text{day}^{-1}$. $\beta^{-}$ particles are emitted with a maximum energy of $0.61 \text{ MeV}$.
